name: io.github.Shailesh200/prism
title: Prism
description: Local-first Software Intelligence Engine for coding agents — repository DNA, health, blast radius, Dispatch jobs, and MCP tools over your open project. No cloud upload for core analysis.

packageArguments.description: Optional absolute path to the repository root. Defaults to nearest git root from the client cwd.

environmentVariables.name: PRISM_WORKSPACE
environmentVariables.description: Optional override when the MCP client starts from a directory outside the project.

environmentVariables.name: CURSOR_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Required to spawn local Cursor SDK workers from start_job. Briefing, connect, and remember work without it.

environmentVariables.name: PRISM_DISPATCH_ROLE
environmentVariables.description: Set to worker by Dispatch when attaching Prism MCP to a job agent, so start_job and start_my_day are hidden.
